post_clip.description: Two individuals approach a checkout counter; one wears an orange high-visibility vest and the other a dark jacket with a hood. The person in the dark jacket appears to be holding or pointing an object (possibly a weapon) toward the cashier, while the person in orange stands close, seemingly complicit. Their posture, proximity to the cashier, and the apparent threat gesture suggest a robbery in progress. No visible violence has occurred yet, but the behavior is highly suspicious and consistent with an armed robbery attempt.

A person wearing a dark hooded jacket and red head covering is leaning over a checkout counter in a manner consistent with attempting to conceal or steal items (e.g., placing items into clothing or bag out of view). Their posture—bent low, hands near the counter surface, avoiding direct line of sight with cameras—is highly suggestive of shoplifting behavior. No staff appear to be intervening, and the individual’s actions deviate from normal customer checkout conduct.
